sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host New Mills at Hind Heath Road on Tuesday evening (7:45pm KO), with both teams currently on 6 points and seeking to strengthen their positions. After a disappointing 3-2 midweek defeat at Foley Meir, The Bach bounced back with a 1-0 victory over Stafford Town on Saturday and will be looking to build momentum. New Mills themselves showed resilience with a 2-1 comeback win over Allscott Heath last Saturday, so this promises to be a competitive affair between two evenly-matched sides.
divisionWide: The division's upper tier remains competitive, with Wolverhampton Casuals (9pts) and AFC Bridgnorth (6pts) both in strong form. Eccleshall have climbed to third with their recent victory over Barnton and now face league leaders Casuals on Wednesday at Brinsford Stadium. Stafford Town, despite their loss to Sandbach, still sit in the promotion picture with a 50th anniversary celebration and FA Vase tie coming up. Lower down, Market Drayton Town remain pointless and face Telford Town in a crucial local derby on Tuesday, while Allscott Heath (1pt) host Shawbury United in a regional derby under the lights. Crewe and Foley Meir round out the evening's fixtures, with both seeking their first wins of the campaign.
